posts.title: CDH Full BSC Performance Cycle 2026 is live
posts.description: Colleagues, our Q1 BSC Goal Setting cycle is open. Align SMART goals to the four perspectives — Financial (30%), Customer (15%), Internal Process (25%), Learning & Growth (30%). Final weighting is 90% objectives / 10% core values. Contact Human Capital Development for support.
